premise.claim: PR body: "RBG status synchronization only compared Replicas and ReadyReplicas, so changes to UpdatedReplicas alone were ignored, leaving stale rollout progress even after repeated reconciliations."
premise.evidence: TestUpdateRBGStatusSSAPersistence fails on base 7894133 (persisted updatedReplicas stays 1 while the observed value moves 1->2->0 with replicas/ready stable) and passes on head 4ab4a5e; see results/integration-base.json and results/integration-head.json
